title: Unified Dairy Feed, Water, Energy, Mineral and Ration Optimization Rules for AI Agent
purpose: Provide one source of truth for animal, herd, KT, dashboard and PDF calculations.
Prevent duplicate formulas from producing conflicting DMI, water, energy or mineral values.
Provide traceable calculation IDs so every displayed value can be reproduced.
Separate scientific equations from software policy thresholds.

scientific_basis.primary_standard: NASEM 2021, Nutrient Requirements of Dairy Cattle, 8th Revised Edition
scientific_basis.important_scope_note: This JSON standardizes the calculations discussed in the feed-calculation review. It is not a complete reimplementation of every equation in the full NASEM dairy model.

core_architecture_rules.rule: All frontend tables, animal tables, herd tables, KT tables, API responses and PDF reports must consume the same calculated result objects. No UI module may independently recalculate DMI, water, minerals or energy.
core_architecture_rules.feed_composition_source: consolidated_minerals.dat plus the validated master feed composition database

relative_humidity_percent.description: May be used for heat-stress advisory logic but is not an input to the official NASEM water Eq 9-1/9-3.

parity_factor.derivation: 0 for primiparous lactating cow; 1 for multiparous lactating cow

dmi_engine.priority_rule: If reliable measured DMI is available, preserve it as measured_DMI and also calculate predicted_DMI for comparison. Do not silently overwrite measured intake.

important_limitations: Published equation does not include an explicit ambient-temperature multiplier.
Do not apply an arbitrary heat-penalty multiplier and still label the result as NASEM Eq 2-1.

growing_heifer_when_diet_ndf_known.preference: Use when ration NDF is known with confidence.

constraints.Week: negative week before calving, limited to -3 to 0

late_gestation_dry_cow_last_3_weeks.bcs_adjustment: If BCS > 4, NASEM notes limited data suggesting estimated DMI may be reduced by 8%.

far_off_dry_cow.rule: Before the last 3 weeks prepartum, use the week-3 value from Eq 12-1 as the dry-period intake estimate.
far_off_dry_cow.note: Do not use BW*0.022 as a universal dry-cow DMI equation.

bull.rule: Do not label BW*0.022 as NASEM dairy bull DMI. Use a separately validated beef/bull requirement model if bulls are included.

calf.rule: Use the NASEM calf model rather than adult/heifer DMI equations.

lactose_fallback.rule: If lactose is not measured and the full milk-component formula is being used, NASEM notes lactose is generally about 4.85%.

general_rules: Water must be available free-choice; predicted water intake is not a ration cap.
Do not calculate one water value in the Animal Engine and another in the KT Engine.
Use the same final/candidate diet composition object used by the ration engine.

inputs.CP_percent: diet crude protein percentage of DM
inputs.NaK: dietary Na + K concentration, mEq/kg DM

lactating_cow_primary.selection_rule: Preferred when a reliable DMI estimate is available.

heifer.rule: NASEM states data for older growing heifers are limited and no equation has been developed to predict FWI.
heifer.software_behavior: Show 'planning estimate unavailable from NASEM equation' unless a separate validated heifer-water model is configured. Never present BW*0.08 as an official NASEM result.

calf.rule: Provide free-choice water. Do not reuse adult-cow water equations.

heat_stress_rule.reason: Ambient temperature is already an input to the recommended equations. A second arbitrary multiplier would double-count temperature unless a separately validated model explicitly requires it.

deprecated_formulas: BW*0.08 for dry/heifer/bull water as an official standard

energy_requirement_engine.critical_rule: Do not mix heifer ME requirements and adult-cow NEL requirements in one unlabeled total.

input_priority_for_calf_birth_weight: configured fallback estimate explicitly labeled as estimated

total.formula: NEL_required = NEL_maintenance + NEL_milk + NEL_gestation + NEL_frame_growth + NEL_body_reserve_change + NEL_other_validated_adjustments
total.rule: Only include components that actually apply and can be calculated from valid inputs.

deprecated_growth_rules: primiparous_maintenance*0.20 as a universal growth allowance

frame_growth.EBG_from_ADG: EBG = 0.85*ADG for pre-first-calving heifer frame-growth calculations

whole_diet_energy_warning.rule: NASEM 2021 calculates ME and NEL on a total-diet basis. Treating each feed as having a perfectly additive fixed NEL and solving a linear LP is an approximation.
whole_diet_energy_warning.preferred_implementation: Use LP/MILP to generate candidate rations, recalculate whole-diet ME/NEL using the validated energy engine, then iteratively re-optimize until energy adequacy and ration constraints converge.
whole_diet_energy_warning.legacy_mode: If fixed feed NEL/ME values are used for linear optimization, label the result as an approximate screening formulation and perform a final whole-diet validation before marking the ration Balanced.

rules: Do not call a diet protein-balanced solely because CP is adequate when a validated MP model is available.
If the current feed database cannot calculate MP reliably, use CP as a temporary fallback and mark protein_basis='CP_fallback'.
Do not invent feed MP values.

mp_to_np_efficiency.note: Apply within the biological/model range used for growing heifers; do not extrapolate blindly beyond maturity.

composition_rule.primary_source: validated feed-specific mineral composition from consolidated_minerals.dat/master feed database
composition_rule.reason: Using generic green/dry/cake values in one table and feed-specific values in another guarantees inconsistent mineral totals.

supply_calculation.natural_feed_supply: sum mineral supplied by all feeds
supply_calculation.supplement_supply: sum mineral supplied by mineral mixture, salt and other mineral supplements
supply_calculation.reporting_rule: Show natural feed and supplement contributions separately, but total adequacy must use their sum.

calcium.rule: Use the full factorial Ca requirement system for maintenance + lactation + pregnancy + growth and account for source-specific absorption when the validated model is available.

phosphorus.rule: Use factorial requirement and absorption logic, not a single fixed dietary P percentage for every animal.

other_minerals.rule: Requirements must come from the validated NASEM mineral requirement module/table for the animal state. This JSON does not invent missing requirement equations for Mg, K, Na, Cl, S and trace minerals.
other_minerals.agent_behavior_if_requirement_missing: Return requirement_status='not_calculated' rather than fabricating a target.

correct_process: Optimize supplement dose subject to label/legal/safety limits.
Add supplement contribution to total supply.

pregnancy_month_fallback.label: estimated_from_pregnancy_month
pregnancy_month_fallback.warning: Pregnancy month is an approximation and creates uncertainty in gestational nutrient requirement.

joint_ration_optimizer.decision_variable: x[group,feed] = kg DM of feed per animal per day for that group

feed_inclusion.formula: min_inclusion <= x[group,feed]/group_DMI <= max_inclusion where validated limits exist

energy.adult_cow: candidate ration must meet adult-cow NEL requirement after whole-diet validation
energy.heifer: candidate ration must meet heifer ME requirement after whole-diet validation

protein.fallback: CP adequacy check only when MP calculation unavailable

constraints.minerals: Required minerals must meet requirement without violating configured tolerable/safety limits.
constraints.fiber: Apply validated NDF/fNDF/starch constraints for the animal class and ration type.

joint_ration_optimizer.reason: Animals with equal or similar DMI can have very different energy, protein, mineral and physiological requirements.

fiber_and_starch_policy.implementation_note: Use the complete validated ration fiber module where possible; the matrix is not a substitute for particle-size, forage quality and physically effective fiber evaluation.

if_infeasible: Calculate the nutrient shortfall under maximum feasible use of current feeds.
Run a purchase/augmentation scenario only from permitted candidate feeds.
Return additional purchase quantity required for each feed.

balance_status_engine.important_rule: DMI adequacy alone can never produce status BALANCED.

major_minerals.maximum: must remain below configured tolerable/safety upper limit

trace_minerals.minimum: meet validated requirement/adequate-intake target where defined
trace_minerals.maximum: must remain below configured tolerable/safety upper limit

default_thresholds_configurable.fiber_and_starch: must pass the configured validated ration structural-carbohydrate rules

classification_logic.INVALID_INPUT: Required inputs for the applicable scientific equation are missing or invalid.
classification_logic.INFEASIBLE_WITH_CURRENT_INVENTORY: No ration can satisfy hard inventory plus essential nutrient constraints.
classification_logic.UNSAFE_EXCESS: A nutrient exceeds a configured tolerable/safety limit.
classification_logic.DEFICIENT: One or more essential nutrients are below minimum policy adequacy.
classification_logic.EXCESS: Essential minimums are satisfied but one or more monitored nutrients exceed the preferred operating band without reaching a safety limit.
classification_logic.BALANCED: All required DMI, energy, protein, mineral, fiber/starch, safety and inventory checks pass.

rules: Do not calculate adequacy when requirement is zero or not defined.
Return null plus a reason instead of Infinity/NaN.
Keep requirement, supply, deficit/surplus and adequacy together in the same result object.

if_formula_inputs_missing.behavior: Use only an explicitly defined fallback formula if one exists; otherwise return not_calculated and list missing inputs.

deprecated_rules_to_remove_from_code.rule: pregnant water = BW*0.09 then *1.44 heat stress
dry/heifer/bull water = BW*0.08 then *1.44 heat stress

deprecated_rules_to_remove_from_code.action: replace with NASEM Eq 2-3/2-4 when applicable
replace with late-gestation NASEM equations when applicable

deprecated_rules_to_remove_from_code.rule: generic Ca/P values by green fodder, dry fodder and cake category
mineral mixture is ignored in 15-mineral total
each animal independently optimized without shared inventory
ration is Balanced when DMI is within +/-5%
calf birth weight = mature BW*0.07 labeled as NASEM
deprecated_rules_to_remove_from_code.action: remove as authoritative; use expected calf birth weight or a validated breed/parity estimate

example_trace_object.note: Agent/backend should populate the calculated value. Example inputs are illustrative and must not be used as farm data.

validation_tests.rule: Animal table water total must equal KT water total when both aggregate the same animals and use the same final ration.
Ca/P totals in animal, herd and 15-mineral tables must be derived from identical feed and supplement supply objects.
No feed allocation may exceed daily available inventory after reserve/spoilage adjustments.
A ration with adequate DMI but deficient energy or protein must not be BALANCED.
If pregnancy month is used instead of insemination date, output must contain estimated_from_pregnancy_month warning.
No extra 1.44 heat multiplier may be applied after NASEM Eq 9-1 or 9-3 unless a separately configured validated model explicitly requires it.
Heifer ME requirement must not be mislabeled as adult-cow NEL.
Every official calculated target must expose its equation_id/source label.
